Title: Dragon's Breath Rounds and Target Vitals

Messages.Author: Kushiel
Messages.Body:
I strike for one with a Saturday Night Special, playing Target Vitals
with the strike. After my opponent declares his strike, I play
Dragon's Breath Rounds. Does the extra damage from Vitals inherit the
aggravated nature of the two points of DBR damage, or does it stay non-
aggravated?

John Eno

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:



The 2 points of additional damage from Target Vitals are not
aggravated.

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/index.php?line=rulings

# Additional damage inherits all of the properties of the base damage
(So the +1 damage from lucky blow is aggravated for Basilia). [RTR ]

# The base damage does not inherit the properties of the additional
damage (So a Saturday Night Special with Dragon's Breath Rounds does 1
normal plus 2 aggravated damage). [RTR ]

# Effects that increase the damage provided by strike cards affect
those cards rather than the striking minion (so the added damage is
the same type as the strike's damage, not the base damage). [RTR
19970630]

Carpe noctem.
